title: Payment API Elevated 503 Gateway Drop
symptoms: Payment checkout transactions dropping with HTTP 503
Database connection pool reported 0 available sockets (50/50 in use)
observations: Active connections hit max pool limit of 50
CPU and memory on application pods remain healthy at 35%
Recent deployment v2.4.1 altered connection lease reaper
evidence: Pool active count dropped from 50/50 to 18/65 after configuration reload
P99 latency stabilized back to baseline 45ms
Zero HTTP 503 errors recorded in subsequent 15-minute telemetry window
verification: Executed load-test runner against /checkout endpoint with 500 RPS — 0 errors
Verified connection cleanup in PostgreSQL pg_stat_activity
root_cause: Database connection pool saturated under concurrent peak checkout checkout traffic post-deployment v2.4.1
resolution: Increased connection pool size to 65 sockets, tuned idle reaper to 30s, and restarted payment-service pods

timeline.event: Incident INC-550 recorded for Payment API
